job.name: ig18_frame
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, vertical 9:16, soft warm nostalgic light, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, warm muted colours, looks like a frame from a heartfelt family film. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermarks anywhere.
job.style_qa: фотореалистичный тёплый ностальгичный кадр, смысл соответствует описанию, без надписей, букв, цифр и логотипов, без искажённых рук и лиц
job.person_note: The woman in the photo inside the frame must be exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, white down shawl), rendered as a black-and-white photograph.
job.meaning: старое фото бабушки в деревянной рамке на столе, рядом очки и чашка — первый кадр
job.prompt: A small old wooden photo frame standing on a lace tablecloth on a kitchen table, the frame holds a black-and-white portrait photo of an elderly woman in a white down shawl (face clearly visible in the frame), next to it a pair of old reading glasses and a cup of tea, soft window daylight, cosy and quiet. Composition: the photo frame centered in the middle of the image, large.
